title: AOT: Cannot determine the module for class <...>Component

labels.name: regression
labels.description: Indicates than the issue relates to something that worked in a previous version

labels.name: area: core
labels.description: Issues related to the framework runtime

body:
## I'm submitting a... 

[x] Regression (a behavior that used to work and stopped working in a new release)
## Current behavior Compilation in prod / AOT mode fails with the given error message for EVERY component in my project, even the bootstrapped ApplicationComponent. All mentioned components are declared in their corresponding modules. JIT works without any errors / warnings / problems, AOT used to work in earlier versions.
